purpose: Teach: 知識人/会派/替わり/積ま/計っ/常用/手作業/シード

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広報誌、知識人インタビュー、特集にしましょう。
lines.en: Let's make the PR magazine feature an intellectual interview.
lines.style: Crisp, decisive opening. Speaks with quiet authority—not rushed, but matter-of-fact. Like someone used to being listened to. Slight lift on the idea itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、二大会派、意見対立、続いています。
lines.en: Yes. The internal divisions are still causing friction between the two camps.
lines.style: Attentive and measured. Acknowledges what she said with a beat of understanding before moving to his point. Steady, reportorial tone—not editorializing, just the facts.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 秋の催事、私の替わりに、誰か出してね。
lines.en: For the autumn event, have someone else take my place.
lines.style: Practical, clear instruction. No apology, no hedging—just telling him what needs to happen. Brief pause before the ask, like she's thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫、新商品が、どんどん積まれています。
lines.en: Yes. New merchandise keeps arriving at the warehouse—it's piling up quickly.
lines.style: Straightforward update. Slightly concerned undertone—not alarm, but the tone of someone noticing something that might become a problem. Speaking as if she asked and he's giving her the honest picture.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 残業時間、しっかり計って、報告して。
lines.en: Make sure you're tracking overtime hours carefully and report back to me.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The kind of instruction that expects compliance without drama. Speaks as though accountability matters here—this is the detail that separates good practice from slipping.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の常用パソコン、更新時期です。
lines.en: Yes. The staff computers are due for an update.
lines.style: Brief, procedural. The tone of checking another box. No elaboration needed—he's keeping the information pipeline moving. Efficient.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 伝統工芸、手作業で、丁寧に作るブランド、応援したい。
lines.en: I want to support that brand—the one doing traditional crafts by hand with real care.
lines.style: Warm shift here. She's thinking beyond the immediate tasks. Slightly softer attack, more personal conviction underneath. Like she's revealing something that matters to her.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。シードラウンドの資金調達、来月、終わります。
lines.en: Yes. The seed round funding will wrap up next month.
lines.style: Confirmatory and final. The tone of someone tying off a thread. Calm certainty—the timeline is set. Slight sense of relief underneath.
